नाथ (ऋ) नाथृ r. 1st cl. (नाथति-ते)
 1. To ask or beg.
 2. To bless.
 3. To
destroy.
 4. To have wealth or power.
 5. To be deceased. उपतापे पर०
आशिषि आत्म० ऐश्ये अर्थने च पर० भ्वा० सक० सेट् ।

नाथ m. (-थः)
 1. A master, a lord.
 2. A name of ŚIVA, especially in the
form of a Linga; it is usually compounded with some word relat-
ing to the legendary history of the Linga, as Somanātha, the
Linga set up by SOMA, &c.
 3. A name adopted by a class of Yogis,
as GORAKSHANĀTHA, &c.
 4. A rope passed through the nose of a
draft ox.
 E. नाथ् to ask, (from whom,) and अच् aff.

नाथवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Dependent, subservient, subject,
 E. नाथ
master, and मतप् poss. aff.

नाथहरि m. (-रिः) An animal bridled by the nose.
 E. नाथ the string,
हृ to take, इन् aff.

नाथहार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Taking or carrying a master, &c.
 E. नाथ, हृ to
take, अण् aff.
